# ML Fundamentals & Model Debugging Drill

[← Apple](../README.md) · [Every Apple question](../../apple.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/ml-fundamentals-and-model-debugging)

`ab-testing` `ads` `debugging` `evaluation` `llm` `ml-knowledge` `transformer`

---

## Requirements

Be prepared for a fast-paced MLE discussion that includes:

1. A classification workflow: cleaning data, creating features, selecting and training a model, evaluating offline and online, and monitoring it.
2. LLM topics: Transformer architecture, SFT, DPO, prompt design, agents, MCP, knowledge distillation, and evaluation.
3. Advertising and ranking topics: binary CTR modeling, DCN v1 compared with v2, bidding goals, CPA construction, and A/B experimentation.
4. Debugging in production: declines in online results, GPU OOM, poor embeddings, metric regressions, and shifts in the data distribution.
5. Adapting to domains: audio processing, image and video compression, multimodal embeddings, and model optimization.
6. Inference and deployment: LLM latency and memory constraints involving KV cache, quantization, and batching, plus the fundamentals of training vision encoders for multimodal and video positions.

## Notes

This round frequently functions as a checklist. Concise, accurate responses are more effective than lengthy tutorials. For each model or metric, relate it to the data format and the product goal: identify the label, note what arrives late, recognize possible bias, determine what can be tracked online, and specify which failure should alert the team.

When troubleshooting a model, organize the response around data -> training -> serving -> metric -> user segment. For GPU OOM, cover batch size, activation checkpointing, mixed precision, sequence length, model parallelism, and leaks in the training loop.

## Preparation

- Create a one-page ML systems checklist that you can recite: data, labels, model, loss, offline metrics, online metrics, serving, and monitoring.
- Develop brief explanations of Transformer attention, SFT versus DPO, distillation, embeddings, and prompt evaluation.
- Rehearse two debugging stories: an online CTR decline following deployment, and a training failure caused by GPU OOM.
- For advertising positions, revisit calibration, delayed labels, auction goals, and the reasons offline AUC can differ from business metrics.
